description: This course covers fundamental concepts of calculus essential for information technology, including limits and continuity; derivatives of algebraic, trigonometric, exponential, and logarithmic functions; techniques of integration such as substitution, integration by parts, and partial fractions; applications of derivatives in optimization and curve sketching; and an introduction to multivariable calculus including partial derivatives and multiple integrals. Students will also explore numerical methods for solving differential equations using MATLAB and Python, and apply calculus principles to real-world problems in algorithm analysis and data modeling.

clos.text: Define the limit of a function and compute limits using algebraic manipulation and L’Hospital’s Rule.
Describe the properties of continuous functions and apply the Intermediate Value Theorem to solve real-world problems.
Explain the concept of derivatives and compute derivatives of composite functions using the chain rule.
Apply integration techniques to solve problems in algorithm complexity analysis and data compression.
Implement numerical integration methods in Python to approximate definite integrals and analyze their convergence.

topics: Integration by Parts and Partial Fractions
Applications of Integration: Area and Volume
